remarks: Nestled on a tranquil street in the Bettswood area, a charming ranch home offers effortless one-level living in a highly sought-after location.Boasting 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom meticulously maintained residence exuding warmth& comfort. You are greeted by a manicured corner lot w/lovely curb appeal. The home features a convenient one-car garage, ensuring ease & convenience for parking/storage. The interior is bathed in natural light, creating a welcoming atmosphere throughout. The layout is thoughtfully designed with a seamless flow from the spacious living areas to the cozy bedrooms. Rooms reflect a blend of comfort&functionality, ideal for both relaxation and everyday living. The kitchen is well-appointed w/appliances & ample cabinet space, perfect for culinary enthusiasts. Separate laundry room provides close access to the garage. The dining area, perfect for hosting gatherings w/family & friends.The property continues to impress w/its beautifully landscaped yard, offering a serene retreat for outdoor activities or quiet moments of relaxation. The tree-lined street enhances the neighborhood's charm, providing a picturesque backdrop. Conveniently located, the home offers easy access to the Post Road & I-95, facilitating seamless travel. The vibrant SONO Collection is just moments away, offering a myriad of dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Commuting to NYC effortless w/nearby Metro-North train access, making city adventures accessible. A East Norwalk gem!
